query: How can clinics improve triage and scheduling?

per_column.name: clinical_severity_level
per_column.rationale: A severity axis distinct from raw urgency is highly useful for triage improvement. Most rows are sound readings (viral URI as acute_significant is defensible, EF-preserved post-MI as chronic_stable is apt). However the annual physical with mild fatigue labeled chronic_stable overstates a documented chronic condition where none is clearly stated, showing occasional over-inference.

per_column.name: workup_and_diagnostic_demand
per_column.rationale: Diagnostic resource demand is directly relevant to scheduling and slot allocation. Values are well grounded: labs ordered->labs_only, MRI/echo->imaging_required, exam-only URI->clinical_decision_only. Strong extraction fidelity.

per_column.name: treatment_intervention_complexity
per_column.rationale: Intervention complexity is a valuable axis for resourcing visits. Several values are grounded (topical+oral for acne->medication_initiation_complex, viral URI->counseling_support). But the annual physical labeled medication_adjustment has no medication change in the text, and knee-injury MRI-to-rule-out labeled procedural_or_surgical is premature since no procedure is documented yet.

per_column.name: time_criticality_for_intervention
per_column.rationale: Time-to-intervention is central to triage prioritization and offers leverage beyond the coarse urgency field. Values track the text well (routine follow-ups->routine_weeks, acute injury/URI->urgent_hours_to_days). Some overlap with urgency but the finer granularity adds value.

per_column.name: visit_type_and_slot_profile
per_column.rationale: A slot/visit-type profile is directly actionable for scheduling optimization, the core of the query. Mostly grounded, but labeling the post-MI follow-up and the annual physical as brief_follow_up is an assumption about visit length/type not clearly supported; the annual physical is arguably a preventive_wellness visit, indicating some misclassification.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide genuinely distinct, actionable axes (severity, diagnostic demand, intervention complexity, time-criticality, slot profile) that go well beyond the original coarse fields and directly support triage/scheduling analysis. Groundedness is generally solid with clean extraction of labs/imaging cues, but there is recurring mild over-inference on the routine annual-physical row (asserting chronic status, medication adjustment, and follow-up type not evidenced) and one premature procedural label, lowering groundedness modestly without undermining overall quality.
